info.name: PhotoSort
info.summary: Organise photos and videos into date/device folders
info.description:
A Nextcloud port of the PhotoSort desktop tool. Pick a source folder from your Files, choose how the output should be organised (by camera/device and date, or date-first), confirm a destination folder, and the server sorts your photos and videos into a clean hierarchy.
Routing mirrors the original PhotoSort engine exactly: photos go under <camera-model>/YYYY/YYYY-MM/YYYY-MM-DD/, screenshots into screenshots/, EXIF-less photos into misc/, videos matched to a device (container metadata or proximity to a nearby photo) alongside the photos, and unmatched videos into unmatched-videos/. Exact duplicates (same SHA256) are routed to duplicates/.
Sorting runs as a detached background worker, so the browser tab is just a dashboard — close it and the job keeps going. The real PhotoSort Python engine is bundled and run with vendored Pillow + hachoir; no system packages required.
Dry-run is on by default so you can preview the layout before any files move.
info.author: immanuel-lam
